message: You know, there’s a certain warmth that comes from finally being the prepared one. Just the other day, my granddaughter was over, and we were playing a game when the power flickered out. Instead of a scramble, I calmly reached for my trusty go-bag, complete with snacks and a flashlight. She looked at me with wide eyes, and I couldn't help but chuckle. It felt good to show her that being ready can be a little adventure of its own. 😊 Have you ever surprised yourself with your own preparedness?
